description: agentd's facts about a task, carried in Task.metadata under https://agentd.dev/a2a/ext/task-annotations on an answer to a request that activated it.

askChannel.description: where an INPUT_REQUIRED gate is also announced: the channel of the instruction document's human it is addressed to

askSchema.description: the JSON Schema of the answer an INPUT_REQUIRED gate asks for

command.description: the command op that started the task

consentGate.description: the person's consent gate the task waits on (RFC 0044 §5.10): an action gate the person approves or denies with delegation.approve or delegation.deny — reading its nonce and argument hash from delegation.list — or a sign-in the IdP asked for, at start_uri or at verification_uri with user_code

link.description: what the task tracks: a workflow run, a subagent, or a conversation turn

securityGate.description: the INPUT_REQUIRED gate is one agentd raised itself — a security.policies ask, a Company's gate — never a model's ask_human or a workflow's human step; a client shows it with a badge no question text can earn

signIn.description: where the person signs in at their IdP for the enrolment the task is (RFC 0044 §5.4): a single-use start link on the listener origin, good until expires_at (epoch ms), which their own browser opens — never the IdP's URL

spanId.description: the W3C span id the task's work is done in, 16 lowercase hex digits: the span a `traceparent` response header names

statusHistory.description: every state the task has been in, oldest first

traceId.description: the W3C trace id of the task's work, 32 lowercase hex digits

title: agentd task-annotations
